XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Injection control unit

  • Fault: “OIL LEVEL TOO HIGH” warning

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: One or more of the following errors:
    • 2C6C00 (Engine oil level too high)

    • 35BD00 (Reduced engine oil change interval)
  • Cause: Inappropriate injection control unit software

• Action: Check the engine oil level:
    1. If it is too high, carry out the oil level reset procedure

    2. If it is correct, this indicates a software fault in the injection control unit which can only be resolved by carrying out the relevant update
  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: WARNING :
    • If there are any DTCs or symptomatic conditions other than those listed, resolve them before proceeding with this bulletin.

    • To carry out the update, the vehicle’s battery must be fully charged or supported by a battery charger or auxiliary battery to ensure a nominal voltage of 12V. Switch off all lights and accessories to prevent the battery from discharging.
    Estimated time required to restore the engine oil level: 40 minutes.

    Estimated time required to restore the engine oil level and carry out the software update for the injection control unit: 1 hour and 25 minutes
